product.title: The Ultimatum
product.description: Set the bar high with "The Ultimatum" snowboard. Our high-performance board, made with a carbon fiber and bamboo core and a triaxial fiberglass wrap, delivers an unforgettable experience for advanced riders. This board is designed for versatility and control, with a twin shape and a hybrid camber profile that delivers excellent edge hold and pop. It has been tested by our team of experienced riders, ensuring that it is ready for any challenge. Whether you're hitting the park or exploring the backcountry, "The Ultimatum" will give you the freedom to ride with confidence.
